display_name: Hermes Fitness Posture Coach（自用健身体态/动作教练）
role: Self-use fitness_posture domain pack for visual-conversation-core: exercise taxonomy, camera coaching, low-risk posture cues, evidence/safety gates.
promotion_policy: evidence-gated ratchet: metadata seed -> local pose smoke -> low-risk movement pilots -> local UI; every promotion needs current proof/readback and ledger update; no commercial/media/default camera promotion without explicit evidence gates.

source_weighting_policy.preflight: Load this project profile, visual-conversation-core skill, SSOT/contract/ledger, and source evidence index before implementation.

weights.rule: Defines owned capability boundary and safety gates.
Lead/caption evidence only; verify all claims upstream.

source_weighting_policy.conflict_rule: If social claims conflict with README/API/data or local proof, prefer upstream/local proof and keep adoption fail-closed.

red_lines: no medical diagnosis or injury treatment
no heavy-load coaching without stop gate
no raw camera/video cloud upload by default
acceptance: exercise seed script builds derived index/report
taskpool cards include safety and evidence gates

backend_contract_policy.contract_scope: Self-use fitness posture domain pack, exercise metadata, local pose adapter, low-risk coaching contracts, review UI, and safety gates.
backend_contract_policy.schema_rule: Changes must preserve existing evidence/projection records; migrations must tolerate historical sparse profiles and malformed task evidence without global failure.
backend_contract_policy.compatibility_rule: Projection/control-plane additions remain additive and fail closed; no external dispatch, hardware, deploy, credential, or lifecycle write without exact authority/readback.
backend_contract_policy.side_effect_boundary: No push/deploy/external send/hardware action/credential entry/destructive mutation by default.

required_checks: pose adapter smoke with no-stub fail-closed receipt
low-risk movement fixture tests before runtime claims
UI/browser smoke when review UI changes

lark_task_execution_policy.primary_goal: Advance this project only through evidence-backed, profile-scoped local slices while preserving hard authority gates.
execution_order: read project profile and progress ledger
lark_task_execution_policy.closeout_rule: Closeout requires structured evidence, focused verification output, and explicit boundary notes; advisory/model agreement alone is not completion authority.
